## Install

- **Windows 10 and 11**: download `Ramure_…_x64-setup.exe` and run it. It installs for the current user, without administrator rights. The installer is not signed yet: on the first run, Windows shows "Windows protected your PC". Choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
- **Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04**: download `Ramure_…_amd64.deb`, then `sudo apt install ./Ramure_…_amd64.deb`. Or download the `.AppImage`, make it executable (`chmod +x`), and run it.

Ramure needs Git 2.23 or later.
